why Skoltech?
All faculty members have decades of active research experience from top global universities
Monthly scholarship up to 55,000 rub/month (≈$680) for highest-scoring applicants
Significant freedom in choosing courses, an individual study plan that allows students to obtain a modern education with a broad interdisciplinary component
Industrial immersion: Students take internships at leading corporations and research centers
Open dynamic international environment that brings together hundreds of scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs with ambitions. English is our language of instruction and communication
Unification fundamental science with real-life applications. Skoltech transfers new technologies to the market, support and develop hi-tech startups, offer an extensive portfolio of courses in entrepreneurship & innovation
scholarships and benefits
Students receive a scholarship based on the results of the competitive selection: for MSc students: 40,000 rubles per month; for PhD students: 75,000 rubles per month
International students are covered by insurance in accordance with the local Skoltech policies
All students can take part in different academic exchange programs with Russian and foreign universities
